messages:
Jules: Heads-up — we need to lock press brief cadence for next week's launch. main asks: 1) list of analyst slots by timezone 2) who will own quotes + factcheck shepherding 3) embargo check-in. Can folks volunteer? :wave:
Priya: I can own quote stewarding. happy to collect approved soundbites and route them to legal.
Marco: I can handle EU/APAC scheduling windows. prefer block times: 09:00-11:00 and 16:00-18:00 CET for analysts.
Lena: I'll curate the quote bank — send me the short answers (2 lines max). Also add product PR bullets to the fact sheet.
Jules: Great. @Priya can you put together a single doc for quote approvals? also need a clear fallback if an analyst asks for changes during embargo.
Priya: Will do. Drafting a template now. I'll include: name, org, requested quote, quote owner, legal status (ok/needs redline), requested publish time.
Alex: FYI — legal wants any vendor-name references to be pre-cleared. If a journalist asks for usage metrics, route to me first.
Marco: For scheduling: I'll post a rotation grid. Quick ask — who on-call for same-day briefing swaps? (e.g., if a slot cancels last minute)
Jules: @Marco could you add a 2-hour buffer column for swaps? We'll roster Alex + Priya as first contacts for last-minute fills.
PressBot: Automated reminder set — embargo window reminder will go out 24h and 2h before lift.
Priya: Uploaded initial quote template: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/quote-template (please review). Also added a small checklist for factcheck: source links, metric provenance, PR-approved phrasing.
Lena: Putting together the quote bank now. Quick format rule: bold the short quote, italics for attribution line, keep source links inline.
Marco: Posted rotation grid in the doc. snippet:
```
UTC Slot,Region,Analyst,Backup
09:00,Americas,Sam,Alex
13:00,EMEA,Marina,Marco
22:00,APAC,Yuri,Alex
```
Jules: Love it. One more — embargo handling flow: 1) send factpack + quote draft 48h before embargo, 2) receive redlines within 24h, 3) final signoff 4h before. If no signoff, default to approved-by-PR. Thoughts?
Priya: That timeline is tight but workable. add a firm max of 2 substantive redline rounds.
Alex: Agreed. And log all changes in the doc with time stamps. I'll review any metric redlines.
Lena: I'll maintain the change log. tagging @all when a quote moves to legal.
Jules: OK looks like we have owners. I'll send calendar invites for the rotation shifts and ping the press list with embargo rules tomorrow morning. Thanks team :rocket:
